jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.desc: Why loveholidays? At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away. We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams , you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams. The impact you’ll have: As our Senior CRM Executive, you will play a key role in delivering and improving CRM campaigns and customer journeys across our channels. You’ll be close to the detail of campaign build, journey optimisation and performance, with the opportunity to grow your ownership over time. You’ll work closely with the CRM Manager, Head of CRM and wider Marketing, Product and Engineering teams to turn agreed customer opportunities and briefs into well-executed campaigns and journeys. You’ll help move us away from legacy campaign cycles by building reliable, increasingly automated lifecycle activity. We are looking for a thoughtful, high-velocity operator who can turn clear direction into accurate live journeys. Your day-to-day: You’ll build and maintain multi-channel automated journeys using branching logic, API triggers, and real-time data, working from agreed briefs and priorities. Identify manual bottlenecks and support the implementation of AI-assisted workflows, using tools like n8n and Claude (training will be provided). Use Braze to identify optimisation opportunities within your journeys and help make delivery faster, more accurate, and more consistent. Provide hands-on campaign support to the wider team in deploying campaigns. You’ll ensure accurate execution through rigorous, increasingly automated QA processes. Work collaboratively with Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver agreed workstreams and help create a frictionless experience from search to rebooking. Monitor the performance of your campaigns and journeys. You’ll be comfortable using Looker to maintain reports, monitor health metrics, and surface actionable insights that support optimisation. Your skillset: You are a reliable operator who takes ownership of your assigned campaigns and journeys from brief through deployment. You ask the right questions, flag risks early, and deliver with consistency and precision. You can move from a clear brief to deployment rapidly, maintaining high standards and following agreed processes. You are naturally curious and look for practical ways to improve processes, reduce manual tasks, and make delivery more efficient. You have experience with Looker, Tableau, or SQL, and BQ and confidence using data to monitor performance. Hands-on experience with Braze or similar. You should be comfortable with Liquid logic, audience segmentation and personalisation. You are comfortable working with data models and propensity scores to support relevant segmentation and measure campaign impact. The ability to work well across Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams, taking direction and communicating clearly to keep delivery on track. Desirable: Experience supporting CRM activity across multiple international markets, including handling localisation, consent frameworks, and currency differences within automated journeys Familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools Experience writing Liquid logic for content personalisation Exposure to AI-assisted workflows or agentic tooling Background in travel, marketplace, or another high-frequency transactional category The interview journey: Meeting with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager Final Stage interview in office presenting pre-determined task and a meeting a few stakeholders - 1 hour 30 mins Perks of joining us: Company pension contributions at 5%. Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up. Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends. 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum. Ability to buy and sell annual leave. Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers. At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey. jobs.title: AI Unity Tools Engineer
jobs.desc: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio. You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made. What you'll do Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games. Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable. Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality. Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling. Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used. Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations. Requirements Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke. Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it. Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions. Sharp thinking. jobs.title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.desc: About Papers Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth. Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments. What We Are Looking For Essential Experience & Qualifications 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines. Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality. Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts. Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools. Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably. CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho. Preferred Technical Skills Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations Mindset & Soft Skills Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture. Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning. Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment. Working Environment & Expectations Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast. Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win. Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. Why join Papers? Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means. High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes. Influence the Growth strategy from day one. Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth. 25 days paid vacation per year. Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).
